title: Claude automates data-broker opt-outs #claude #dataremoval #privacy
description:
Claude is being used to automate data broker opt-out requests and remove personal information from the internet. With Claude Connectors and a custom “identity eraser” skill, it can search broker sites, open removal forms, and submit requests using your details.

The key insight is not just that AI can handle repetitive privacy tasks, but that home addresses, phone numbers, ages, and family links are already widely exposed across broker databases. In one test, the setup removed records from a dozen different sites.

This points to a broader shift in consumer privacy: AI tools are becoming practical agents for navigating fragmented, form-heavy systems that most people would never manage manually. The real value is time saved, reduced exposure, and a clearer view of how easily personal data is collected and distributed online.
